alarmRootCauses: AlarmRingingModal was mounted in both tabs layout and task-manager screen; asynchronous starts could overwrite the only player/timer reference.
Pending audio/preview startup could continue after stop, and a pause exception could skip player removal.
Alarm actions stopped audio only after successful persistence; a database failure left it ringing.
A future snooze fell through to the original due-minute check.
Simulation reused real task actions and could dismiss/complete a real task; cancelled core tasks were still alarm candidates.
changes: Single root modal after database readiness; restore remount stops the old audio session.
Generation guards cancel pending starts/previews and queued vibration; independent mute/pause/remove cleanup.
Every modal action and hardware back stops audio immediately; persistence failures are reported after silence; repeat actions are guarded.
Test has a dedicated stop button and ten-second timeout without task mutation.
Pending snooze skips the original schedule; current occurrence stays silent in memory if its database dismiss fails; cancelled tasks excluded from alarm candidates.
Weekly multi-day creation validates all rows and commits one batch transaction; form catches failure, retains its draft and guards duplicate submit.
Settings read errors propagate; read-after-write is inside the transaction; prayer location is published after commit.
Settings saves are queued; committed values stay visible, errors are exposed, stale reads are ignored, location forms close only after success.
